decision.reason: [ev-bfb9c0ed4d28] says only that the http-wasm host was upgraded to v0.6.0 so that clients using v0.4.0 are supported. That supports the subject product-relationship http-wasm and the after value "v0.6.0". It never states the previous host version, so the proposed before value "v0.5.0 or earlier" is made up, and value-changed requires a before value. To settle the change aspect I need evidence of the previous http-wasm host version, such as a go.mod or dependency diff between releases; otherwise the change should be re-typed, and the text alone does not settle that.
